what_the_class_is: The stereo delay as a whole: a line an output with a loop around each, the Fb Mode byte sending each loop home or across, the damping pole inside the loops, a Phase byte a side turning the delayed copy over, the balance of dry against wet, then the level and tone stages.

era.when: Mid nineteen-nineties, a custom fixed-point DSP running its effects at 32 kHz with a small control processor beside it.
what_that_implies: A delay is a circular buffer addressed by a sample count, so a time is a whole number of samples and a tap is one more read of the same buffer; three or four taps cost three or four reads and no more memory.

A loop takes a read of the buffer, scales it and adds it to what is written, and damping in it is the cheapest pole there is -- one multiply and one state -- because it only has to take the top off the repeats.
Whether the value fed back is the read of this sample or of the last one is a question of how the program is scheduled, and either costs the same.
Times, rates, levels and corners are tables indexed by the byte, as the classes that read them closed on; a whole-type model borrows those tables rather than fitting its own.
era.would_be_wrong_if: The repeats of a held or struck note came back at spacings other than the ladder entry (or the entry and a sample) at settings nothing here was built on, or their level fell per repeat by other than the printed feedback times the damping pole.

candidates.reading: The Phase bytes turn a side's delayed copy over on its way out only, after the loop has taken it. The loop returns straight off the line at the ladder entry.
candidates.predicts: With feedback, every repeat of a side turned over when its Phase byte is Invert, and a time of 0 has no order to be drawn in.

candidates.reading: The Phase bytes turn a side's delayed copy over on its way out only, after the loop has taken it. The loop returns through a second read of the line one sample past the ladder entry.
candidates.predicts: With feedback, every repeat of a side turned over when its Phase byte is Invert; each repeat one sample later than the ladder puts it, which grows by a sample a repeat.

candidates.reading: The Phase bytes turn a side's delayed copy over inside the loop, so the copy fed back is turned over too. The loop returns straight off the line at the ladder entry.
candidates.predicts: With feedback and a side at Invert, that side's repeats alternate in sign, and in Cross mode what that side sends the other is turned over too; a time of 0 has no order to be drawn in.

candidates.reading: The Phase bytes turn a side's delayed copy over inside the loop, so the copy fed back is turned over too. The loop returns through a second read of the line one sample past the ladder entry.
candidates.predicts: With feedback and a side at Invert, that side's repeats alternate in sign, and each repeat lands one sample later than the ladder puts it.

what_no_candidate_here_predicts: What a Phase or Fb Mode value past 01 does beyond keeping the state 00: every take asking one asked it straight after 00, and the states claim reads it as leaving the slot where it stood, which a take written from another state would contradict.
Anything at the addresses the page does not print: no node reads them, so every candidate renders them as the power-on state.
Whether the damping claim, closed on the stereo delay and checked on the mod delay, reaches this type's HF Damp byte: it is carried here unmeasured, one pole on the line's input inside the loop.
